content: {"like": ["visuals are truly unforgettable", "the narrative is very nicely done", "the French team makes it clear that the French soldiers fought bravely during the German invasion", "the film remedies the failure of many accounts of Dunkirk to mention the French soldiers who held off the Germans"], "dislike": ["the French team emphasizes the British, French and Russian roles in winning the war and deemphasizes, sometimes shamefully so, the American role", "the voice-over makes it seem that it was primarily British paratroopers who dropped behind enemy lines on the night before D-Day", "the film comes down firmly on the side of those who maintain that the fire bombing of Dresden was justified by the city's military importance, rather than acknowledging the controversy"]}
